text.autoconfig.chunkscanner-debugger.op: Log detailed framework information, including registration details and action execution traces.
Append an exception stack trace summary (up to 5 frames) to chat when a debug action fails.
chunkscanner-debugger.feature.csUnlockCo: Makes ConfigurationLocker treat every config item as unlocked (isLocked returns false, getValueLocked returns null). Combined with 'Disable Apply All' this bypasses server config locking entirely.
chunkscanner-debugger.feature.csDisableC: Disables ConfigurationLocker.applyAll so locked values are no longer force-written to the active config. Only blocks replay; does not clear the 'modification forbidden' flag.
chunkscanner-debugger.action.csConfigura: Calls ConfigurationLocker.setAuthorized to unlock the given paths, simulating server authorization. Accepts multiple paths at once.
Calls ConfigurationLocker.setLocked to lock and immediately replay path=value. Omitting the value means lock without a forced value.
